name: RepairBuddy — Mirror Coder Experiment
actions: scan the latest Technical Glasses seams against stored repair patterns
run a live verifier-linked scan from the CLI: node tools/repairbuddy/repairbuddy-cli.js scan
route verifier warnings by frozen replay, evidence collection, or repair design: node tools/repairbuddy/repairbuddy-cli.js warnings
compare every verifier warning with an explicit digest-bound known-open baseline: node tools/repairbuddy/repairbuddy-cli.js warning-delta
select one warning and prepare separate human and AI-native action packets without automatic open or apply
look underneath a module's files and code: node tools/repairbuddy/repairbuddy-cli.js eyes <moduleId>
propose repairs from lineage-bound patterns without write authority
preview and explicitly replay only fixed fields from a frozen verified recipe, with exact preconditions, verifier evidence, receipt, and rollback
build an escalation prompt for a platform AI when no pattern matches
validate a returned pattern file against the pattern gate before a human installs it
summary: Deterministic repair memory and complete warning-delta support. Known warnings stay open; new, resolved, or changed warnings become explicit without suppression. Only frozen copy-only replay recipes can write after an explicit human preview gate.
notes: The configured pure Mirror source is untouched. RepairBuddy has no learned weights and no language organ. It cannot create code, acknowledge warnings, rewrite its baseline automatically, or adapt a repair. Its only write authority is an explicit, verifier-bound replay of fixed values from a lineage-backed recipe, with rollback.
